evidence_boundary: Illustrative portfolio change requests used to exercise statistical impact assessment. They are not sponsor protocol amendments, approved SAP changes or production change-control records.

changes.title: Safety population definition change
changes.description: Illustrative change from observed exposure as the safety criterion to a revised protocol-defined safety population rule.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a population-definition change propagates through subject flags, ADAE context, safety denominators and all safety-population TLFs.

changes.title: TEAE follow-up window change
changes.description: Illustrative change of the treatment-emergent AE follow-up window from 30 to 45 days after treatment end.
changes.rationale: Tests whether an event-window rule change reaches the ADAE TRTEMFL derivation, TEAE TLFs and each programming/reviewer QC layer that reconstructs TEAE status.

changes.title: Primary ACTOT visit change
changes.description: Illustrative change of the primary ACTOT analysis focus from Week 24 to Week 16, including planning, estimand, MMRM and missing-data sensitivity review.
changes.rationale: Tests propagation from endpoint timing into analysis datasets, ANCOVA/MMRM displays, estimand and both fixed-delta and subject-level MI sensitivity specifications, protocol-design assumptions and the randomisation count linked to the planning scenario.

changes.title: Primary MMRM covariance change
changes.description: Illustrative change of the primary longitudinal covariance structure from unstructured to heterogeneous AR(1).
changes.rationale: Tests whether a model-specification change reaches MMRM fit/inference QC, every MMRM TLF and the downstream fixed-delta sensitivity calculation that uses the primary Week 24 contrast.

changes.title: Treatment-discontinuation intercurrent-event strategy change
changes.description: Illustrative change from a treatment-policy strategy for treatment discontinuation to a hypothetical strategy.
changes.rationale: Tests whether changing the scientific question for a key intercurrent event reaches the estimand specification, observed-data MMRM path, longitudinal outputs, missingness review, fixed-delta sensitivity and subject-level MI sensitivity assumptions.

changes.title: Fixed-delta MNAR sensitivity assumption change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the adverse delta range or scenario multipliers used to stress missing Week 24 ACTOT outcomes.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a sensitivity-analysis assumption change forces regeneration of the sensitivity inputs, T18/T19, QC evidence and controlled missing-data documentation.

changes.title: Subject-level MI sensitivity assumption change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the rbmi imputation count, longitudinal imputation model, Monte Carlo precision threshold or Week 24 delta scenarios.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a controlled MI assumption change forces regeneration and review of the pairwise MI diagnostics, Monte Carlo QC, T20/T21 and the corresponding SAP/missing-data documentation.
